color.description: Accent color for the time and progress bar
color.label: Color

on_expire.description: Shell command run when the timer reaches zero (the only alert there is), e.g. `hey hook -f on-timer-expire "$duration"`. Available: $duration (the countdown's length, in seconds).
on_expire.label: On expire

notify_color.description: Color while the timer is up; empty inherits the widget's own colors
notify_color.label: Expired color

running_color.description: Color while the timer counts down; empty inherits the widget's own colors
running_color.label: Running color

show_idle.description: Show or hide the widget when timer stopped at zero
show_idle.label: Show count when idle on horizontal bar
